assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service directly addresses the documented symptomatic episodes for which the clinical criteria support this specific diagnostic modality.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied.
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines.
The clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were not met.
No payment will be issued for this encounter.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
A formal request for reconsideration must be submitted within the designated timeframe.
Additional clinical evidence supporting medical necessity should be included.
Failure to appeal within the specified period may result in the loss of the right to contest this decision.
